title: Wiki page frontmatter (OKF v0.2 + CHARTE §5)
description: Machine-readable counterpart of the CHARTE §5 field table, for pre-flight validation by agents that prepare pages outside the repository. Authority rule: CHARTE.md and tools/lint.py are authoritative; this schema follows. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are noted per field and enforced by the lint: `verified` must NEVER be set at page creation; `covers` is forbidden outside syntheses; no page may cite a synthesis in `sources`; a synthesis at status `stable` requires a `verified` entry with a `human:` actor; internal `covers` targets must exist and be linked in the body; a page carrying `code_refs` must carry `stale_after`; `source_file`/`conversion` are reserved to raws ingested from binary documents and always appear together; `applies_to` targets must exist.

type.description: The only field OKF itself requires.

description.description: One sentence. It is the index line: agents scan title+description before opening.

items.description: Kebab-case. A new tag is allowed if no existing one fits; flag it in the commit message.

status.description: draft = medium confidence, incomplete, open contradiction.

stale_after.description: Required (by convention, not by the lint) when the page cites a version, a service state, a price, any dated figure. A date, never a datetime.

verified.description: NEVER set at page creation — only after real verification. `human:` actor = human review, reserved for the owner or on their explicit instruction. An agent re-checking against an independent source puts its own actor.

covers.description: The pages a synthesis derives from, as bundle-relative paths. REQUIRED on type: Synthesis; FORBIDDEN on every other type (the lint enforces the prohibition — a JSON Schema cannot). Every target must exist and be linked in the body; no target may itself be a synthesis.

routing_review.description: Required when the page was parked in the closest-fit bundle (CHARTE §7.3). Removed once the page is relocated or the attachment becomes final — the log entry says so.

candidate.description: Suspected bundle, or omitted when none is identifiable yet.

contested.description: Open between-sources contradiction affecting the core of the page. The weekly lint lists contested pages and resolves them by rotation; removed once the contradiction is settled.

content_sha256.description: Raw sources only (raw/ directory): sha256 of the converted body without the frontmatter, set at ingestion only, never recomputed. Used to deduplicate re-ingestion of the same URL.

code_refs.description: References to code (CHARTE §13.2). REQUIRED on type: Decision. A page carrying code_refs MUST also carry stale_after — a pinned commit IS a version (the lint enforces the coupling). Never fabricate an entry: a sha you have not seen does not get written.

applies_to.description: The system areas a piece of knowledge is about, as bundle-relative paths (CHARTE §13.2). Plain link — existence checked by the lint, no derivation coupling (that is `covers`). Recommended on Decision/Constraint.

source_file.description: Provenance of a raw ingested from a binary document (CHARTE §13.2/§13.5). RESERVED to such raws — forbidden on every other type; always appears together with `conversion` (the lint enforces both rules). Its sha256 hashes the ORIGINAL binary and is the document-level dedup key.

name.description: Basename of the original binary, e.g. system-spec-v3.docx.

sha256.description: sha256 of the ORIGINAL binary — the document dedup key (distinct from content_sha256, which hashes the converted body). Two raws sharing it under different dates are a re-ingestion (lint); same-date sharing is a chapter split (CHARTE §13.5).

stored_at.description: Public URL of the original, or a non-identifying storage slug like "storage:project-docs".

size_bytes.description: Optional size of the original binary.

conversion.description: How a binary document was converted to markdown (CHARTE §13.2). RESERVED to document-ingested raws, inseparable from `source_file`.

id.description: Stable slug, used as the footnote anchor in the body.

resource.description: PUBLIC URL of the source — never a private URL (CHARTE §2). Direct observation without a public URL: "observation:<YYYY-MM>".

then.description: A synthesis must declare the pages it derives from.
A Decision cites the code it concerns (CHARTE §13.2).

repo.description: Public canonical URL, or a bare slug for a local repository without a forge (wiki and code repositories are decoupled, CHARTE §13.6).

commit.description: FULL 40-hex sha — never a branch, never an abbreviation.

path.description: POSIX-relative path, no leading slash, no `..`.
